ios.NSCameraUsageDescription: Unterwegs uses the camera to scan the sign-in QR code and to take photos for your trip.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Unterwegs needs access to your photos to upload them to locations, lodging and transportation.
ios.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Unterwegs shows your location on the map and uses it when you add a place where you are.
ios.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Unterwegs uses your location only while the app is open: on the map and when you add a place where you are.
ios.NSLocationAlwaysUsageDescription: Unterwegs uses your location only while the app is open: on the map and when you add a place where you are.
